title: PLAYER 2S BEST SHOT LANDS
why: Found while designing the Forge. In two player co-op, player 2 works out the damage of each round and the host applies it, but the host threw away any hit over 600 as junk. The Longshot does 170 since v21.66, so a Longshot round into a Choir DORSAL SPINE is 612: player 2 saw the number and the Choir took nothing. The limit is now 1500, above every real hit (including the upgraded guns the Forge brings), and still far below a broken number.
now: Player 2 Longshot rounds into a Choir weak point land on the host again.
